interpretation: Exact conflict combinatorics and rounding-bin sensitivity on one archived 20-row source segment. Local and UTC event dates coincide on every row; no alternate per-row date mapping is justified. This neither identifies a production rule nor licenses per-date exception handling.

frozenPlan.scope: Exact, source-local cause analysis of the Helsinki 2026 full-run Isha tie-only affine infeasibility. No source requests, API access, runtime changes, date-specific exceptions, or public-file edits.

inputs.role: Frozen private inverse report; select its printed-date-actual-IANA full-run Helsinki 2026 Isha source cells.
Original archived 365-row calendar response; independently reparse local date and Isha clock strings for the selected cells.
Archived source-file identity, acquisition record, city identifier, and frozen checksum.
Archived city timezone designation for local-wall-clock to UTC conversion.
Exact installed IANA zone file used to verify date/offset conversion.

frozenPlan.frozenQuestion: For the selected n full-run Isha source minute cells (x_i,u_i), find the minimum cardinality subset with no affine line y=a+b*x satisfying the stated rounding cells; enumerate every minimum subset if feasible. Prove all smaller cardinalities feasible. Then independently test explicit half-minute tie conventions, symmetric vertical tolerance, and endpoint/transition-date variants.
frozenPlan.primaryRoundingCell: Nearest integer minute, ties later: u_i-1/2 <= a+b*x_i < u_i+1/2, exact rational arithmetic.
frozenPlan.SubsetMethod: Enumerate subsets in increasing cardinality. For each subset use exact pairwise intercept-interval compatibility to project onto a free slope interval, preserving endpoint openness. Stop at first cardinality with infeasible subsets; report all subsets of that size and exact contradiction witnesses. Verify every smaller subset, not merely one deletion-minimal core.
TiePolicies: ties to even: both endpoints included for even u, excluded for odd u
closed-bin relaxation: [u-1/2,u+1/2], closure-only upper bound, never a source policy
frozenPlan.Tolerance: For each selected set and convention, widen each bin symmetrically by delta >= 0: [u-1/2-delta,u+1/2+delta], changing endpoint openness only according to the named tie policy. Solve the exact infimum delta and whether it is attained; report positive minimum versus zero-limit tie-only feasibility separately.
frozenPlan.BoundarySensitivity: Replay exact feasibility after dropping first/last source cells separately and together (trim 1 and trim 2), and after shifting all x by a common +1 day (translation invariance control). Re-evaluate the selected witness against dates/clocks reparsed from the archived original calendar, and verify each local wall-clock to UTC date/index/minute conversion using Europe/Helsinki. No per-row alternate assignment is introduced.
frozenPlan.Reproducibility: Hash and pin this plan and every input before scoring subsets or tolerances. Keep helper/scripts/tests local to this private diagnostic directory.

publicExport.omitted: Original clock rows, repeated witness lists for alternate policies, and redundant tolerance comparison details. Primary minimum witness dates, exact bounds, counts and statuses retained.
